pages.title: Mirror Microbe
pages.text: $(thing)Mirror Microbe$(): A bacterium built mirror-handed, as everything in the Antiverse is. Nothing alive can digest it, and nothing in a body can grip it: its touch gives the Mirror Plague, which no Anomaly Ward holds. Only a Mirror Antibody wards it. Found drifting in the Antiverse.$(br2)$(thing)Drops$(): Chiral Crystal, Mirror Cell.
